summary: [¶] Determination of transmission tariff for 400 kV S/C Singrauli-Allahabad Line along with associated bays at both ends including 1X50 MVAR Line Reactor at Allahabad end under Northern Regional System Strengthening Scheme-XXX under Regulation 86 of Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 1999 and Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2014. [para 6] 6. Punjab State Electricity Board Thermal Shed Tia, Near 22 Phatak, [para 8] 8. Power Development Department Government of Jammu & Kashmir, Mini Secretariat, Jammu. [para 14] 14. Chandigarh Administration Sector -9, Chandigarh. [¶] The instant petition has been filed by Power Grid Corporation of India Limited for determination of transmission tariff for 400 kV S/C Singrauli-Allahabad Line along with associated bays at both ends including 1×50 MVAR Line Reactor at Allahabad end under “Northern Regional System Strengthening Scheme-XXX”, from the anticipated date of commercial operation to 31.3.2019 under Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2014 (hereinafter referred to as “2014 Tariff Regulations”). [para 3] 3. It is observed that the instant petition was filed under the 2014 Tariff Regulations as the asset was anticipated to be put into commercial operation on 1.1.2019. However, the asset is now anticipated to be put into commercial operation on 31.7.2019, during the 2019-24 tariff period. Therefore, the petitioner is directed to file a fresh petition as per the provisions of Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019. The filing fee paid by the petitioner in the instant petition will be adjusted in petitions to be filed by the petitioner in future. [para 4] 4. In view of the above, the instant Petition No. 370/TT/2018 is disposed of. [¶] sd/sd/- **(Dr. M.K. Iyer) (P. K. Pujari) Member Chairperson**
title: Determination of transmission tariff for 400 kV S/C Singrauli-Allahabad Line along with associated bays at both ends including 1X50 MVAR Line Reactor at Allahabad end under Northern Regional System Strengthening Scheme-XXX under Regulation 86 of Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 1999 and Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2014.
